theorem bounded_observables_subsequence (value : Nat → Nat → Nat) (bound : Nat → Nat)
    (bounded : ∀ k i, value k i ≤ bound k) :
    ∃ stage : Nat → Nat, (∀ i j, i < j → stage i < stage j) ∧
      ∀ k n, k ≤ n → value k (stage n) = value k (stage k) := by
